0022600136.text: The Orlando Magic (1-2) visit the Toronto Raptors (2-1) in a regular-season game that is Orlando's fourth of the 2026-27 season, and the teams have not met yet this season. The Magic lost 1-2 in the 2025-26 season series, including a 139-87 loss in Toronto on March 29, 2026. Orlando is 0-2 at home and 1-0 on the road, on a one-game winning streak, and sits 10th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, while Toronto is 1-0 at home and 1-1 on the road, on a one-game losing streak, and sits 5th in the East and 3rd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, and Paolo Banchero, and Anthony Black is listed as day-to-day with a personal reason and a game-time decision, while Toronto is without Brandon Ingram, Kawhi Leonard, and Nate Bittle.
